new_jobs.jd: **The team and the role:** **The Personal Workspace Solution group from Logitech is committed to help people create and communicate their passion and work to the world, anytime anywhere. You will be tasked with delivering amazing video image quality by combining image acquisition, image analysis, image quality tuning, image processing, computational photography, computer vision, AI Machine Learning and Deep Learning. You will be responsible for analyzing, designing, specifying and implementing video solutions addressing the needs of current and future generations of products in overall objective and subjective image/video quality as well as integrating them in current and future video capable products.** **You will stay on top of the latest innovation in both hardware for our products (sensor, SoC, …) but also equipment required to test and validate our product. Understand the runtime environment of algorithms on ISP hardware, GPU, NPU, and multi\-core CPUs. **●** Experience in both objective image quality in laboratory environments and subjective image quality in real world user scenarios. **● Familiarity with imaging standards, certification and organizations, Microsoft Teams, Zoom, VCX, SPIE, ...** **●** Proficiency in: **o** Color Science, Camera Image Signal Processing, Digital Video **o** OpenCV, Deep Learning, Matlab, GPU programming, Imatest **o** C / C\+\+ / Python software programming * Linux and RTOS environments
